title: Nano banana - construction sprite sheet using my AI gen image. 😵
author: OpusGeo
selftext:
This is golden age for solo game devs.  
  
I used text below with uploading my image to gemini while nano-banana section is clicked.  
  
give me a construction stages of this image for use in game engine as sprite sheet. edit and progress frame by frame

comments.author: OpusGeo
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/f8pyu2rdqrpf1.png?width=711&format=png&auto=webp&s=dde38ce9df9a49b1034362e7e81aa5a0ffc20a50

This is what you will see

replies.author: StealthyRobot
replies.body:
But why do the windows get replaced with a door? And the house changes size too.

There's much better programs that chatGPT that give you much more control.

replies.author: OpusGeo
replies.body: I dont know what to say man. Gpt produces per img in at least 1min. Gemini gives 4img  in seconds

replies.author: DangerousImplication
replies.body: It’s not even the same shape as original

replies.author: Nixellion
replies.body: Make sure to use 2.5 Flash. Pro uses a different model. And do 1 image at a time, an hit retry if something is wrong. Repeat until ypu get a good image then proceed to the next.

replies.author: OpusGeo
replies.body: Hey now I understand why i get one img. Thanks

replies.author: WishIWasALemon
replies.body: Best ive seen for that is godmodeai.co but it isnt free anymore unfortunately. I used it a bunch for free in july trying it out and when i went to use it last week it had been chsnged to subscription :( but im paying for gpt pro so ill probably make the switch when i need to work on characters.

comments.body: image 2 has windows instead of the door, continuity is broken

replies.author: KaizenBaizen
replies.body: This is so funny to me. Not the first time I’ve seen this happening. People are sometimes so hyped and forget to look at the details.

replies.body: Sometimes you change your mind and want to rebuild it to a door. lgtm

replies.author: Tarc_Axiiom
replies.body:
Image 3 is also a different size.

As in, the footprint of the building changes. If you put this in a game that change will cause problems.

replies.author: epic-cookie64
replies.body:
From experience nano banana is very good at consistency, not changing stuff that needs to be changed.  
I believed OP has used 2.5 pro image generation.

comments.author: BoysenberryHour5757
comments.body: Can the layers be completely separate?

replies.author: BoysenberryHour5757
replies.body: Completely separate as in the second picture would be just the windows, the third picture would be just the roof, and so on. I was asking because i thought it would be really good method for 2D->3D asset pipeline. Once all the layers are 3D they can all be put together in software to make a more detailed asset

comments.author: Efficient_Mud_5446
comments.body: It's so hard to get consistency right. Until thats perfected, the image generators do not make good sprite sheets. We're getting there.

replies.author: Nixellion
replies.body:
Banana is very good at consistency.

I suspect its one of two problems - OP might've used the 2.5 Pro chat, which uses a different image model, which is older than banana and does not do editing well.

Or you need to do 1 sprite at a time and maybe with more careful prompting, telling it exactly what to do, and working backwards from the final image (remove roof, remove upper half of walls, etc).

replies.author: epic-cookie64
replies.body: Yeah. From experience, nano banana only changes stuff that is relevant to the prompt.
